lemma: # Our own definitions, for lemmas whose short definition (LSJ's first sense, as Logeion cut it)
# misleads: a wrong homonym, a grammatical label, or a rare or early sense put first. Read by
# scripts/lemma_definitions.py, before anything else. front (optional): the flashcards' front,
# "-" for the lemma alone (μήν: a particle and a noun, two words under one lemma).

definition: truly, surely (particle); month (noun: ὁ μήν, μηνός)
I will say, speak (future of λέγω); (Epic) to ask

lemma: # A grammatical label for a meaning

definition: self; the same (ὁ αὐτός); him, her, it

lemma: # A rare or early sense put first

definition: to order, command, bid; to urge
to crush, shatter, break in pieces
to think, suppose; to glorify, honour
eternal, everlasting; lasting for an age
to beg, ask, pray; to need, lack
to visit, look after; to inspect
to confess; to praise, give thanks
